r1.exp: 1=E (Erin: 'My host was DUTCH' = European origin). 2=C (Chris: 'Budapest is now first on my ever growing list of places to see'). 3=F (Fabian: 'most POSH neighbourhood, king size bed and a JACUZZI'). 4=E (Erin: 'had no manners... really looking for a babysitter... yelled at me... hitch-hiked out'). 5=D (Dana: 'begged my parents to let me couch-surf with Bella... it was in vain so BELLA WENT ALONE'). 6=A (Aida: 'as true Poles WE PREPARED OUR BEST DISH for a warm welcome'). 7=B (Benjamin: 'had a laugh sharing our stories... They had recently spent five months couch-surfing through Europe meeting strange people'). 8=A (Aida: 'it was the other way around with my mom... WE HOSTED' = mum persuaded Aida). 9=B (Benjamin: 'My girlfriend and I have BEEN TRAVELLING across the USA FOR THE LAST TWO WEEKS'). 10=C (Chris: 'They came in with bags of groceries, intent on REPAYING THE FAVOUR by cooking us dinner'). 11=D (Dana: 'I BEGGED MY PARENTS to let me couch-surf'). 12=F (Fabian: 'I've couch-surfed ALONE numerous times').

r19.exp: 'You don't get dressed by putting on every piece of clothing you like. (19)_____. Too many gardens are made up of every plant.' → C: And you shouldn't approach your garden this way either.

r20.exp: 'Decide on your style. (20)_____. Grouping plants that naturally grow together is effortless.' → H: Then choose plants to match. (Match your plant choices to your chosen style.)

r21.exp: 'Sun-loving plant cannot thrive in shade. (21)_____. One way is to choose a structural plant that REPEATS through the garden.' → A: Give the garden a RHYTHM that DRAWS THE EYE from one place to another.

r22.exp: 'Gardens are not merely extensions of the interior. (22)_____. Seasons change them and every season brings its own colours.' → F: They are DYNAMIC, CHANGING spaces.

r23.exp: 'Fade into burnt oranges and brilliant reds. (23)_____. Sometimes a red starts to bloom too early, so there's often a clash.' → E: However, it's rare that this happens FLAWLESSLY.

r24.exp: 'Rules are to be broken. (24)_____. But do so unapologetically.' → G: Bend them ALL AT ONCE if necessary.

r25.exp: 'On the UPPER pay scale' — 'upper' za gornju razinu plaće (senior teachers).

r26.exp: 'Have been UNABLE to recruit deputy heads' — 'unable' = nesposobni, nije im uspjelo (adjective, correct collocation).

r27.exp: 'MOREOVER, a sample highlights worries' — 'moreover' za dodavanje nove informacije koja potkrepljuje prethodnu (uz to, štoviše).

r28.exp: 'The NQTs they HAD RECRUITED in the past two years' — past perfect za radnju koja je prethodila prošloj radnji (said → had recruited).

r29.exp: 'Six OUT OF ten' — fiksni izraz: X out of Y = X od Y (šest od deset).

r30.exp: 'An exodus DUE TO concerns about workload' — 'due to' + noun phrase za uzrok (concerns = imenica).

r31.exp: 'Schools are HEADING for a serious crisis' — frazalni glagol: head for = biti na putu prema, kretati prema (negativnoj situaciji).

r32.exp: 'A serious crisis, WHICH will inevitably have an impact' — ne-restriktivna relativna zamjenica 'which' (uz zarez, odnosi se na krizu).

r33.exp: 'ACCORDING to recent studies' — fiksni izraz: according to = prema (izvoru informacija).

r34.exp: 'Are now BEING forced to change their recipes' — present continuous passive: are + being + past participle.

r35.exp: 'Labels that show HOW healthy each product is' — neizravna upitna konstrukcija: show how + adjective + subject + verb.

r36.exp: 'In OUR diet' (posvojna zamjenica, 1. lice množine) ili 'in A diet' (neodređeni član).

r37.exp: 'Other spreads DO' — ellipsis (izostavljen ostatak surečenice): peanut butter does fit this category = peanut butter DO (auxiliary verb u odgovoru na 'neither...nor...fit').

r38.exp: 'Ingredients LIKE/WITH/INCLUDING/CONTAINING trans fats' — 'like' ili 'including' za primjer, 'with/containing' za sadržaj.

r39.exp: 'ANOTHER way is to avoid eating out' — 'another' za dodavanje još jednog načina (one way... another way).

r40.exp: 'The choices you MAKE now' — 'make choices' = donositi odluke (fiksna kolokacija).

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA rješenja: pristup znanju, interaktivnost, individualizirano učenje, priprema za digitalni svijet. ZA nove probleme: distrakcije, ovisnost, tehničke smetnje, nejednaka dostupnost. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (discuss both views + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
